summary: The candidate provides a working string-based embedding JSONL workflow and offline encode path, but its advertised OpenAI-compatible loader rejects token-ID inputs accepted by SGLang's embedding API and accepts whitespace-only input rejected by that API. It is a meaningful partial fix, not a full resolution.

tests.what_was_measured: At the recorded base, argparse rejected the missing embedding dataset mode, reproducing the original feature absence.

At the exact candidate, all four focused added regressions passed, covering string payload preservation, malformed/short string workloads, offline encode dispatch, and rejection of online-only fields.
The candidate rejected valid List[int] and List[List[int]] embedding inputs accepted by SGLang's EmbeddingRequest, while accepting a whitespace-only string with zero tokens.
Changed Python implementation files compiled successfully from the candidate checkout.
Candidate diff contained no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was detected with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2, but the candidate's cited model/runtime artifacts were absent and no model numerical run was repeated.
remaining_counterexamples: A JSONL embedding request with input [101, 102, 103] is valid under SGLang's EmbeddingRequest and OpenAI embedding input schema but the candidate loader raises ValueError.
A JSONL embedding request with input [[101, 102], [103]] is valid under SGLang's EmbeddingRequest but the candidate loader raises ValueError.
A JSONL embedding request with a whitespace-only string is accepted by the candidate loader with zero input tokens, then rejected by the serving layer as empty.
remaining_limitations: The full 49-test module was externally terminated after six passing tests; the four changed focused tests passed independently.
The candidate's prior MI355X/Qwen numerical claims were not independently repeated because its private runtime/model artifacts were absent in this review environment.
vLLM server interoperability was not executed.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
